title: Exploring Robustness of LLMs to Paraphrasing Based on Sociodemographic Factors

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM question answering accuracy and perplexity on context prompts that have been paraphrased to reflect male, female, and gender-ambiguous linguistic styles.

Measuring the performance disparity of LLMs on a question answering dataset (SocialIQA) that has been paraphrased to mirror the informal and formal linguistic styles of young, middle-aged, and older demographics.
